validation.notes: Repaired DefaultResourceLoader.reload in packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts:451-456: the resolver result was previously discarded and setProjectTrusted(true) was always called, so a denied project trust decision became approval. It now applies setProjectTrusted(projectTrusted), preserving the bootstrap pass (loadProjectTrustExtensions forces untrusted, lines 435-441), the denied final set, and later approved reloads while user/global and CLI resources stay loaded. Ran the exact validation command from the workspace root: exits 0 using only Node 24 built-ins (node:assert/strict plus .prale-eval/subject.mjs), no npm install or network. The regression asserts bootstrap excludes project extensions, denied decisions keep trust false and extensions limited to user/CLI across repeated and fresh reloads, approvals include project resources, and reloads without a resolver respect the existing trust state. It was also replayed against the original fault (setProjectTrusted(true)) and failed there with AssertionError 'a denied decision must not mark the project trusted' (true !== false), so it detects this stage's fault rather than merely printing success.
